name: fmsg
description: Share Claude sessions as fmsg threads, and resume any fmsg thread as Claude context.
long_description: Share your Claude session with anyone as an fmsg thread — the whole conversation, or a one-message summary — and open any fmsg thread in Claude with the full conversation as context. Shares are plain Markdown messages: readable in any fmsg client, usable by any agent. Only the conversation text is shared (never tool commands, tool output, or thinking); secrets are redacted automatically; and every share shows a preview and asks before anything is sent.
